steps.en: Get a binary: installer, GitHub release, Docker — or build from source for your backend
steps.zh: 拿到二进制：安装器、release、Docker，或从源码编译

steps.en: Run a GGUF model straight from Hugging Face
steps.zh: 直接跑 Hugging Face 上的 GGUF 模型

steps.en: Downloads the GGUF and runs it on your chosen backend with the quantization and template you set
steps.zh: 下载 GGUF，按你指定的量化和对话模板，在你选的后端上跑起来

steps.en: To serve your own app, start the server instead of the CLI
steps.zh: 要给自己的程序用，就起服务而不是命令行

steps.en: Exposes an OpenAI-compatible API; or link libllama and call it inside your process
steps.zh: 暴露 OpenAI 兼容接口；也可链接 libllama 进你的进程

value.en: Inference stays an implementation detail you own — same code path from an RTX box to a Mac to a CPU laptop
value.zh: 推理始终是你自己掌控的实现细节：同一条代码路径，从 RTX 机器到 Mac 再到纯 CPU 笔记本

sources: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp README Quick start (install paths; llama cli -hf; llama serve -hf; OpenAI-compatible server)
README Acknowledgements + lib llama API / llama-server REST API links (libllama embedding, server surface)
